content.title: What channel is Michigan vs UConn national title game? Time, TV, stream
content.text: Updated April 6, 2026, 7:57 p.m. ETEditor's note: Follow Michigan vs. UConn updates in the national championship game.With one game left in the college basketball season, Michigan basketball is on the precipice of its second-ever national championship.The 1-seed Wolverines face the 2-seed UConn Huskies in the national title game of the 2026 NCAA Tournament on Monday, April 6, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. The game is scheduled for an 8:50 p.m. ET start time and will be on TBS, with streaming available on Sling TV.After losing in the Big Ten championship game to Purdue, Michigan has won five straight NCAA tournament games, including a 91-73 beatdown of 1-seed Arizona in the national semifinal on Saturday, April 4. UConn, meanwhile, outlasted 3-seed Illinois for a 71-62 win in the other national semifinal game on Saturday.Watch national title game on Sling TVThe Huskies, led by coach Dan Hurley, are playing for their third national championship in four seasons after winning the tournament in 2023 and 2024. UConn has won six national championships overall, all since 1999, as it has established itself as one of the premier college basketball programs of the 21st century.Michigan, meanwhile, finds itself in a familiar position playing in the national title game for the eighth time in program history. However, the Wolverines are 1-6 overall in the big game, with its lone win (and only national title) coming in the 1989 tournament with an 80-79 win over Seton Hall.Here is what you need to know about Monday's title game. What time is Michigan basketball vs UConn in national title gameTime: 8:50 p.m. ET.Date: Monday, April 6.Location: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis. What channel is Michigan basketball vs UConn in national title gameChannel: TBS (simulcast on TNT and truTV).Tipoff: 8:50 p.m. ET.Streaming: HBO Max, Sling TV.Audio: Westwood One.Monday's national title game between Michigan and UConn can be seen on TBS with simulcast broadcasts available on TNT and truTV. Streaming will be available on HBO Max and Sling TV.Watch Michigan-UConn on Sling TV Michigan basketball odds vs UConn in national title gameSpread: Michigan by 6½ points.Over/under: 144½ points.Moneyline: UConn (+260), Michigan (-325).Odds provided by BetMGM as of Monday morning. Michigan vs UConn prediction for national title gameTony Garcia, Detroit Free Press: Michigan’s run to the title game has been historic, becoming the first team to score 90 points or more in its first five games. UConn has been a true power, with an elite coach, now playing for its third national title in four years. U-M has barely stumbled as it puts together an all-time season and it won’t come now. The Wolverines get their second national title. The pick: Michigan 87, UConn 76. Michigan vs UConn announcersPlay-by-play: Ian Eagle.Analysts: Grant Hill, Bill Raftery.Sideline reporter: Tracy Wolfson.CBS will have its A-crew in Indianapolis for the national title game on Monday. This is Eagle's third Final Four after taking over for longtime play-by-play man Jim Nantz.
